script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars in Gemini at 16° forms a tight square to your ruling planet Venus at 15° Pisces, creating explosive tension between your 3rd House of Communication and 11th House of Hopes. If partnered, expect a fiery debate about shared finances versus personal freedom tonight; if single, an ex may resurface via a group chat—your Taurean loyalty could pull you back, but Mars warns against it. Mercury in Aquarius sextiles Jupiter in Cancer, flooding your 10th House of Career with a lucrative freelance offer or promotion—act before March 15 to secure it. Your Earth sign pragmatism is essential: avoid signing any contracts today—one hidden clause under this square could trap you for years. Follow for tomorrow’s reading when Venus enters your 2nd House of Income, triggering an unexpected cash influx.
